messages:
maria gomez: Quick coordination for candidate Hannah Green visiting Thu 2026-06-10. She requested a quiet interview room, ability to take a short break between panels, and extended time for the coding exercise (60m). Also asked for the hands-on prompt in advance to reduce anxiety. Can we support?
tyler ng: We can offer the extra 15m. Ill shift the coding block to 14:00-15:15 and ask panelists to keep finals light. Need confirmation that giving the prompt early is allowed.
accessibility-bot: Accessibility policy: candidates may request adjustments. Extended time and quiet room approved; sharing the high-level prompt is allowed (no solutions). Recommend sending a one-paragraph problem statement 24h prior.
ash (typo) ash rao: Reserving Quiet Room Q2 (ground floor) 13:30-16:00 and arranging noise-canceling headphones. We will place a sign "Private interview in progress" and keep elevator access clear.
devex-bot: DevEx checklist: create temp org hannah-test-2026, pre-seed dataset, pre-clone repo on loaner. Confirmed: org created, repo cloned to loaner (asset TAG LB-7710).
maria gomez: Thanks Ash/DevEx. @tyler ng please confirm panelers are ok with the edited schedule and the 24h high-level prompt. Also candidate asked about parking reimbursement and a quiet lactation room (she's breastfeeding).
tyler ng: I pinged all interviewers. Mira P. and Dan L. approved extended time and receiving the summarized prompt. Lactation room note: facilities confirm Room L4 available; include in invite. Parking: visitor lot B reimbursement policy applies (<$50 auto).
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-06-10T13:00:00-07:00 to 2026-06-10T16:00:00-07:00. Panels: Intro 13:00-13:30, System 13:40-14:20, Coding 14:00-15:15 (extended). Zoom included for remote fallback.
maria gomez: I'll draft the access email to Hannah with Quiet Room details, lactation room location, parking pass instructions, and the 24h high-level prompt note. Tagging Accessibility for wording.
accessibility-bot: Suggested wording: "If you'd like the high-level summary of the hands-on prompt 24 hours in advance, we can send a short paragraph describing the task (no solutions or test cases). Please confirm if you'd like this accommodation."
tyler ng: All good. One logistics ask: can someone ensure the loaner laptop has the test repo and an English keyboard? Candidate prefers US layout.
devex-bot: Confirmed: loaner LB-7710 has repo, US keyboard, and is charged. It will be in the check-out basket labeled "Hannah Green".
maria gomez: Perfect. I'll send the candidate email now and attach the accepted accommodation note. Thanks everyone 680
